words.enDefinition: an account used to manage and pay for household services

examples.en: The utility account stayed in my name until the new tenant moved in.
examples.zh: 新租客搬进来之前，「公用事业账户」一直在我名下。

examples.en: I checked our utility account before asking my roommate to pay her share.
examples.zh: 请室友付她那份钱之前，我先查了我们的「公用事业账户」。

words.enDefinition: a company that supplies a household service such as electricity

examples.en: Our utility provider lets us see a year's worth of charges online.
examples.zh: 我们的「公用事业供应商」允许我们在线查看一整年的费用。

examples.en: Ask the utility provider whether the quoted price includes the daily charge.
examples.zh: 问问「公用事业供应商」，报价里是否包含按天收的费用。

words.enDefinition: a list showing how the total utility charge was calculated

examples.en: The utility bill breakdown shows how little water we actually used in July.
examples.zh: 「公用账单明细」显示，我们七月实际用水很少。

examples.en: I sent everyone the utility bill breakdown before collecting their shares on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五收钱之前，我把「公用账单明细」发给了大家。

words.enDefinition: an amount set aside to help cover basic household services

examples.en: The housing office said the utility allowance was already included in my grant.
examples.zh: 住宿办公室说，我的助学金已经包含了「公用费用补助」。

examples.en: We asked whether the utility allowance changes for students who live alone.
examples.zh: 我们问了独居学生的「公用费用补助」是否有不同。

words.enDefinition: with utility service costs covered by the advertised price

examples.en: A room with utilities included would make it easier to plan my spending.
examples.zh: 如果租金「包含公用费用」，我就更容易规划每月开销。

examples.en: They advertised the flat with utilities included, so we asked which bills counted.
examples.zh: 广告上写这套公寓「包含公用费用」，所以我们问了具体包括哪些账单。

words.enDefinition: to arrange for essential services at a home

examples.en: We need to set up utilities before the first night in our flat.
examples.zh: 我们需要在搬进公寓的第一晚之前「开通公用服务」。

examples.en: The landlord showed us how to set up utilities when we collected the keys.
examples.zh: 我们领钥匙时，房东告诉了我们怎么「开通公用服务」。

collocations: set up utilities before moving in
set up utilities in your name

words.expression: put the utilities in my name
words.lemma: put the utilities in my name
words.zhGloss: 把公用账户转到我名下
words.enDefinition: to register oneself as the person responsible for utility charges
acceptedZhAnswers: 把公用账户转到我名下
acceptedEnVariants: put the utilities in my name

examples.en: I can put the utilities in my name if you handle the internet.
examples.zh: 你要是负责办宽带，我就「把公用账户转到我名下」。

examples.en: When my roommate left, I asked how to put the utilities in my name.
examples.zh: 室友搬走后，我打听了怎么「把公用账户转到我名下」。

collocations: need to put the utilities in my name
agree to put the utilities in my name
ask how to put the utilities in my name

words.enDefinition: to move an existing utility account to another property

examples.en: Can I transfer a utility account to my new address before I get the keys?
examples.zh: 我能在拿钥匙之前先把「公用服务账户转到」新地址吗？

examples.en: You may need both addresses on hand to transfer a utility account when moving.
examples.zh: 搬家办理「公用服务账户转移」时，你可能需要准备好新旧地址。

collocations: transfer a utility account to a new address
transfer a utility account when moving

words.enDefinition: the last bill issued when a utility account ends

examples.en: The final utility bill arrived two weeks after we handed back the keys.
examples.zh: 我们交还钥匙两周后，收到了「公用服务结清账单」。

examples.en: Please send me the final utility bill so I can pay my share.
examples.zh: 请把「公用服务结清账单」发给我，我好付自己那份。

words.enDefinition: the number that identifies your account with a utility company

examples.en: Write your utility account number at the top of the form before sending it.
examples.zh: 寄出表格之前，请在顶部写上你的「公用服务账号」。

examples.en: I found the utility account number on the first page of my statement.
examples.zh: 我在账单第一页找到了「公用服务账号」。

words.enDefinition: the address where a company sends bills or payment notices

examples.en: I changed my billing address because letters still went to my old hall.
examples.zh: 信件还寄到原来的宿舍，所以我更新了「账单地址」。

examples.en: Check that your billing address matches the one registered with your bank card.
examples.zh: 确认「账单地址」与银行卡登记的地址一致。

words.enDefinition: the property address where a service is supplied

examples.en: The service address is my flat, but the bills go to my parents.
examples.zh: 「服务地址」是我的公寓，不过账单寄给我爸妈。

examples.en: The broadband company asked for the full service address before checking available speeds.
examples.zh: 宽带公司说，需要完整的「服务地址」才能查可用网速。

words.enDefinition: the practice of sending bills electronically instead of by post

examples.en: I switched to paperless billing because post often goes missing in our building.
examples.zh: 我们楼里常有信件丢失，所以我改用了「无纸化账单」。

examples.en: With paperless billing, you get an email whenever a new statement is ready.
examples.zh: 使用「无纸化账单」后，每次出新账单都会收到邮件通知。

words.enDefinition: a bill calculated from predicted rather than measured usage

examples.en: The estimated bill was high because the flat had been empty all summer.
examples.zh: 「估算账单」金额偏高，因为那套公寓整个夏天都空着。

examples.en: If you receive an estimated bill, compare it with the number on your meter.
examples.zh: 如果收到「估算账单」，就拿它跟表上的读数核对一下。

words.enDefinition: a new version of a bill that corrects earlier charges

examples.en: The supplier issued an amended bill after we sent photographs of both meters.
examples.zh: 收到我们发的两张表的照片后，供应商开出了「修正后的账单」。

examples.en: Wait for the amended bill before collecting any more money from your housemates.
examples.zh: 等「修正后的账单」出来，再向合租室友收钱。

words.enDefinition: a change to an amount previously charged on a bill

examples.en: The bill adjustment appeared the following month after they checked the account history.
examples.zh: 他们查完账户记录后，这笔「账单金额调整」在下个月显示出来了。

examples.en: I asked the supplier to explain each bill adjustment before paying the balance.
examples.zh: 付清余额之前，我请供应商解释每笔「账单金额调整」。

words.enDefinition: an amount taken off a bill or applied to future charges

examples.en: A bill credit appeared on our statement after we reported an overpayment online.
examples.zh: 我们在网上报了多付款的情况后，账单上多了一笔「抵扣额」。

examples.en: My housemate used the bill credit to reduce what we owed in March.
examples.zh: 室友用这笔「账单抵扣额」减少了我们三月应付的钱。

words.enDefinition: the amount of utility charges that still needs to be paid

examples.en: I cleared the outstanding utility balance before closing our shared account last week.
examples.zh: 上周关闭共同账户之前，我付清了「未付的公用费用」。

examples.en: The email lists an outstanding utility balance from before we moved into the house.
examples.zh: 邮件列出一笔我们搬进去之前产生的「未付公用费用」。

words.enDefinition: utility charges that were not paid when due

examples.en: The student advice centre helped us find a way to deal with utility arrears.
examples.zh: 学生咨询中心帮我们想办法处理「拖欠的公用费用」。

examples.en: He asked if the utility arrears could be paid over several months instead.
examples.zh: 他问能不能把「拖欠的公用费用」分几个月付。

words.enDefinition: a warning that an essential household service will be disconnected

examples.en: A utility shutoff notice arrived while I was away for reading week.
examples.zh: 我在阅读周离校期间，收到了一份「公用服务停供通知」。

examples.en: We called immediately after the utility shutoff notice was pushed through the door.
examples.zh: 「公用服务停供通知」从门缝塞进来后，我们马上打了电话。

collocations: respond to a utility shutoff notice

words.enDefinition: a charge for restarting a service that was disconnected

examples.en: Ask whether the service reconnection fee will be added to next month's bill.
examples.zh: 问问「服务恢复费」会不会加到下个月的账单上。

examples.en: Our housemates agreed to split the service reconnection fee evenly between four people.
examples.zh: 我们四个合租室友同意平摊「服务恢复费」。

words.enDefinition: the stopping of a service such as electricity or water

examples.en: The advice centre explained who to call if we faced utility disconnection.
examples.zh: 咨询中心解释了遇到「公用服务停供」时该给谁打电话。

examples.en: They discovered the utility disconnection was scheduled for a day after their move.
examples.zh: 他们发现「公用服务停供」安排在他们搬走后的第二天。

words.enDefinition: a scheme that helps households pay basic utility charges

examples.en: A campus adviser told me where to apply for the utility assistance program.
examples.zh: 校园顾问告诉我去哪里申请「公用费用援助计划」。

examples.en: The utility assistance program helped my roommate stay current on her winter charges.
examples.zh: 「公用费用援助计划」帮助我室友按时付清了冬季费用。

collocations: apply for a utility assistance program
qualify for a utility assistance program
enrol in a utility assistance program

words.enDefinition: to register as a new customer with a utility supplier

examples.en: We tried to open a utility account on the day we got our keys.
examples.zh: 拿到钥匙那天，我们就试着「开立公用服务账户」。

examples.en: Bring your lease if you want to open a utility account in person.
examples.zh: 如果想现场「开立公用服务账户」，记得带上租约。

collocations: open a utility account in person
open a utility account with the provider

words.enDefinition: to formally end your account with a utility company

examples.en: Our supplier needs a final reading to close a utility account at this address.
examples.zh: 要在这个地址「注销公用服务账户」，供应商需要最后一次读数。

examples.en: You can close a utility account without cutting off supply for the next tenant.
examples.zh: 你可以「注销公用服务账户」，同时让下一任房客继续使用原服务。

collocations: close a utility account after moving
request to close a utility account

words.enDefinition: to move your electricity or gas contract to another company

examples.en: We decided to switch energy supplier after comparing rates on a student advice website.
examples.zh: 在学生咨询网站上比过价格后，我们决定「更换能源供应商」。

examples.en: Before you switch energy supplier, check whether your current agreement has an exit fee.
examples.zh: 「更换能源供应商」之前，先查查当前协议是否收解约费。

words.enDefinition: a company that sells electricity or gas to customers

examples.en: The energy supplier asked me to check the reading on the meter again.
examples.zh: 「能源供应商」让我再核对一遍表上的读数。

examples.en: Our new energy supplier sent the first bill to the wrong email address.
examples.zh: 我们新换的「能源供应商」把第一张账单发到了错误的邮箱。

words.enDefinition: the prices and terms used to charge for energy

examples.en: We asked if a different energy tariff would make our winter bills lower.
examples.zh: 我们问，换种「能源计费方案」能不能减少冬季账单。

examples.en: This energy tariff works well for students who are usually home during the day.
examples.zh: 这种「能源计费方案」很适合通常白天在家的学生。

words.enDefinition: a default energy plan whose rates can change over time

examples.en: We stayed on the standard variable tariff while we compared longer contracts online.
examples.zh: 在网上比较期限更长的合同期间，我们继续用「标准浮动费率」。

examples.en: The supplier emailed to say its standard variable tariff was changing next month.
examples.zh: 供应商发邮件说，他们的「标准浮动费率」下个月会调整。

collocations: move to a standard variable tariff
stay on a standard variable tariff

words.enDefinition: an energy contract with agreed rates for a set period

examples.en: A fixed-rate energy plan sounded sensible while we were sharing the house.
examples.zh: 合租期间，我们觉得选「固定费率能源套餐」比较稳妥。

examples.en: The fixed-rate energy plan ends in June, shortly after my final exam.
examples.zh: 「固定费率能源套餐」六月到期，离我最后一门考试结束没多久。

collocations: switch to a fixed-rate energy plan

words.enDefinition: a pricing plan that covers gas and electricity from one supplier

examples.en: The dual fuel tariff gave us a single statement for gas and electricity.
examples.zh: 用了「燃气电力合并计费」，燃气和用电就只出一张账单。

examples.en: We checked whether the dual fuel tariff was cheaper than buying each service separately.
examples.zh: 我们查了「燃气电力合并计费」是否比分开买两个服务更便宜。

collocations: sign up for a dual fuel tariff

words.enDefinition: a daily fee charged even when no energy is used

examples.en: The standing charge still applied while we were away for the whole break.
examples.zh: 整个假期我们都不在家，但「按天收的固定费」照收。

examples.en: A low unit price can still leave you paying a high standing charge.
examples.zh: 单价低，也可能要付很高的「按天收的固定费」。

words.enDefinition: the price charged for each unit of measured usage

examples.en: The unit rate on our new electricity plan was lower than we expected.
examples.zh: 新用电套餐的「单位费率」比我们预想的低。

examples.en: I checked the unit rate before buying a portable heater for my room.
examples.zh: 给房间买便携暖气之前，我先查了「单位费率」。

words.enDefinition: an electricity plan with prices that vary by time of day

examples.en: A time-of-use tariff works for us because we usually do laundry at night.
examples.zh: 我们通常晚上洗衣服，所以「分时电价方案」适合我们。

examples.en: Ask when each price applies before you sign up for a time-of-use tariff.
examples.zh: 开通「分时电价方案」之前，先问清各档价格的适用时段。

words.enDefinition: the higher price charged during periods of high demand

examples.en: The peak rate starts at five, when everyone is getting home from work.
examples.zh: 大家差不多下班回家的五点，就开始按「高峰费率」计费了。

examples.en: We avoided running the dryer at the peak rate after seeing our first bill.
examples.zh: 看过第一张账单后，我们就尽量避开「高峰费率」时段用烘干机。

words.enDefinition: a lower price charged during quieter periods of demand

examples.en: We run the dishwasher after dinner when the off-peak rate starts at nine.
examples.zh: 晚上九点开始按「低谷费率」计费，我们吃过饭就等到那时用洗碗机。

examples.en: The off-peak rate made it cheaper to heat water in the early morning.
examples.zh: 按「低谷费率」计费时，清晨烧热水更省钱。

words.enDefinition: a separate electricity rate for appliances supplied during set hours

examples.en: The electrician told us our hot water system was on a controlled load tariff.
examples.zh: 电工说我们的热水系统用的是「专用回路优惠电价」。

examples.en: Ask the retailer whether the controlled load tariff covers your storage heater as well.
examples.zh: 问问电力零售商，你的蓄热式取暖器能不能也用「专用回路优惠电价」。

collocations: qualify for a controlled load tariff
switch to a controlled load tariff

words.enDefinition: an electricity price that changes after usage reaches a set amount

examples.en: With a tiered electricity rate, the price can rise as we use more power.
examples.zh: 采用「阶梯电价」时，用电越多，单价可能越高。

examples.en: Our landlord explained the tiered electricity rate when we asked about last summer's charges.
examples.zh: 我们问去年夏天的费用时，房东给我们讲了「阶梯电价」。

collocations: calculate charges at a tiered electricity rate

words.enDefinition: an amount based on how much of a service you used

examples.en: The usage charge dropped after we stopped leaving the heater on overnight.
examples.zh: 我们不再整晚开暖气后，「按用量计的费用」降了。

examples.en: Our water statement lists the usage charge separately from the fixed monthly fee.
examples.zh: 我们的水费账单把「按用量计的费用」和每月固定费用分开列。

words.enDefinition: a fee for delivering energy through pipes or power lines

examples.en: The statement lists a network charge for delivering electricity to our building.
examples.zh: 账单列了一项把电送到我们楼的「供能网络使用费」。

examples.en: I emailed the energy supplier to ask how it calculated the network charge.
examples.zh: 我发邮件问能源供应商「供能网络使用费」是怎么算的。

words.enDefinition: an energy plan linked to electricity from renewable sources

examples.en: Our flatmates chose a green energy tariff because the price difference was small.
examples.zh: 差价不大，所以我们合租的几个人选了「绿色能源费率方案」。

examples.en: Before choosing a green energy tariff, ask how the supplier backs its renewable claims.
examples.zh: 选「绿色能源费率方案」之前，问一下供应商如何证明能源来自可再生来源。

collocations: switch to a green energy tariff

words.enDefinition: a statement for household electricity or gas charges

examples.en: I opened the energy bill while we were discussing the flat's winter budget.
examples.zh: 我们在商量公寓冬季开销时，我打开了「能源账单」。

examples.en: The energy bill went down once all three of us turned off unused heaters.
examples.zh: 我们三个都关掉闲置暖气之后，「能源账单」的金额降了。

words.enDefinition: a statement showing charges for gas supplied to a property

examples.en: We left some money in the shared account for the last gas bill.
examples.zh: 我们在共同账户里留了点钱，用来付最后一张「燃气费账单」。

examples.en: Our gas bill covers the cooker as well as the central heating system.
examples.zh: 我们的「燃气费账单」包含了灶台和中央供暖系统的用气。

words.enDefinition: a fee for collecting and treating used household water

examples.en: The wastewater charge was listed separately at the bottom of our water statement.
examples.zh: 水费账单底部单独列有一项「污水处理费」。

examples.en: We asked whether the landlord normally pays the wastewater charge for this property.
examples.zh: 我们问这套房子的「污水处理费」通常是不是房东付。

words.enDefinition: a charge to fund drainage for rainwater and runoff

examples.en: The city listed a stormwater fee alongside the other charges on our statement.
examples.zh: 市政府把「雨水排放费」和账单上的其他费用列在一起。

examples.en: My landlord said the stormwater fee helped pay for drainage along the street.
examples.zh: 房东说，「雨水排放费」用来分担这条街的排水成本。

words.enDefinition: a fee for access to the public water supply

examples.en: The water service charge stayed the same while usage fell during the holidays.
examples.zh: 假期用水量降了，但「供水固定费」没变。

examples.en: The housing office confirmed that our water service charge includes maintaining the local supply.
examples.zh: 住宿办公室确认，我们的「供水固定费」包含本地供水设施的维护费用。

words.enDefinition: a combined statement for supplying water and handling wastewater

examples.en: We get one water and sewer bill for all three flats in the building.
examples.zh: 楼里三套公寓合收一份「供排水账单」。

examples.en: Please forward the water and sewer bill so I can check the billing dates.
examples.zh: 请转发一下「供排水账单」，我想核对计费日期。

collocations: pay the water and sewer bill
review the water and sewer bill

words.enDefinition: a separate meter measuring usage for one unit within a property

examples.en: The submeter records our usage separately from the rest of the student residences.
examples.zh: 「分户计量表」把我们的用量和学生公寓其他住户的分开记录。

examples.en: I photographed the submeter before moving in so I had my own record.
examples.zh: 搬进去之前，我拍下了「分户计量表」，好自己留个记录。

words.enDefinition: a meter measuring combined usage for more than one unit

examples.en: There is a shared meter for both flats, so our bills are combined.
examples.zh: 两套公寓用一块「共用计量表」，所以账单合在一起。

examples.en: Ask the landlord how costs are divided if the property has a shared meter.
examples.zh: 如果房子用的是「共用计量表」，就问房东费用怎么分摊。

words.enDefinition: a device measuring the electrical energy a property uses

examples.en: Our electricity meter is in a locked cupboard behind the stairs downstairs.
examples.zh: 我们的「电表」在楼下楼梯后面一个锁着的柜子里。

examples.en: Take a photo of the electricity meter when you move in next week.
examples.zh: 下周搬进来时，给「电表」拍张照。

words.enDefinition: a device measuring the gas supplied to a property

examples.en: My flatmate showed me where to find the gas meter under the stairs.
examples.zh: 室友给我指了楼梯下「燃气表」的位置。

examples.en: The gas meter is outside the back door, next to the bins.
examples.zh: 「燃气表」在后门外面，挨着几个垃圾桶。

words.enDefinition: a device measuring how much water passes into a property

examples.en: The water meter kept moving even though every tap in the flat was off.
examples.zh: 虽然公寓里所有水龙头都关了，「水表」还在转。

examples.en: Our water meter was hard to reach because it was behind the washing machine.
examples.zh: 「水表」在洗衣机后边，我们不容易够到。

words.enDefinition: a meter that sends usage readings electronically to a supplier

examples.en: After the smart meter was installed, we could track energy use more easily.
examples.zh: 装上「智能计量表」以后，查看能源用量方便多了。

examples.en: Ask whether the smart meter will keep sending readings if you switch suppliers.
examples.zh: 问问如果换了供应商，「智能计量表」还能不能继续发送读数。

words.enDefinition: a meter that requires credit before a service can be used

examples.en: Our flat has a prepayment meter, so we buy credit before using gas.
examples.zh: 公寓用的是「预付费计量表」，所以用燃气之前先要充值。

examples.en: The landlord explained how the prepayment meter works when she showed us the flat.
examples.zh: 房东带我们看房时，解释了「预付费计量表」怎么用。

words.enDefinition: to add money or credit to a prepayment meter

examples.en: Can you top up the meter before you head out to lectures today?
examples.zh: 你今天出门上课前能「给预付费表充值」吗？

examples.en: I had to top up the meter when the heating went off last night.
examples.zh: 昨晚暖气停了，我只好「给预付费表充值」。

collocations: top up the meter at the shop
remember to top up the meter

words.enDefinition: temporary credit available when a prepaid meter runs low

examples.en: We used emergency credit until the shop where we top up opened again.
examples.zh: 充值点没开门前，我们先用了「应急用量额度」。

examples.en: The meter showed how much emergency credit was left after we switched on the heater.
examples.zh: 开暖气之后，表上显示还剩多少「应急用量额度」。

words.enDefinition: the number shown on a meter at a particular time

examples.en: I wrote down the meter reading before we handed our keys back on Friday.
examples.zh: 周五交还钥匙之前，我记下了「仪表读数」。

examples.en: The supplier asked for a meter reading from the day our tenancy started.
examples.zh: 供应商要我们提供租期开始当天的「仪表读数」。

words.enDefinition: the reading used to start a utility account at a property

examples.en: I sent the opening meter reading so our first bill would start from the right amount.
examples.zh: 我提交了「开账时的表计读数」，这样第一张账单就会从正确读数开始算。

examples.en: The opening meter reading in the landlord's notes matched my photo from move-in day.
examples.zh: 房东记录的「开账时的表计读数」跟我搬进来那天拍的照片相符。

words.enDefinition: the last reading used to calculate charges when an account ends

examples.en: The closing meter reading must be from the day you actually leave the property.
examples.zh: 「结账时的表计读数」要用你真正离开住处那天的数字。

examples.en: I kept a photograph of the closing meter reading in case the bill was wrong.
examples.zh: 我留了张「结账时的表计读数」的照片，以防账单有误。

words.enDefinition: a unique number identifying the physical meter

examples.en: The meter serial number helped us identify which meter belonged to our flat.
examples.zh: 我们靠「计量表序列号」辨认出哪个表是我们公寓的。

examples.en: I checked the meter serial number because the bill showed a different address.
examples.zh: 账单显示的是另一个地址，所以我核对了「计量表序列号」。

words.enDefinition: the UK identifier for a property's gas supply point

examples.en: The new supplier asked for the meter point reference number on my old bill.
examples.zh: 新供应商让我提供旧账单上的「燃气供气点编号」。

examples.en: We needed the meter point reference number when we changed the gas account over.
examples.zh: 我们办理燃气账户转移时，需要提供「燃气供气点编号」。

collocations: look up a meter point reference number
find your meter point reference number
provide your meter point reference number

words.enDefinition: a predicted meter value used when an actual reading is unavailable

examples.en: Once I sent a photo, the supplier removed the estimated meter reading from the bill.
examples.zh: 我传了照片以后，供应商从账单上撤掉了「估算的仪表读数」。

examples.en: Our estimated meter reading was much higher than what the dial actually showed.
examples.zh: 我们的「估算仪表读数」比表盘实际显示的高得多。

words.enDefinition: to send a recorded meter value to your utility supplier

examples.en: We can submit a meter reading through the supplier's app before the deadline.
examples.zh: 我们可以在截止日前通过供应商的应用「提交表计读数」。

examples.en: Please submit a meter reading this week so we can check the bill together.
examples.zh: 请这周「提交一下表计读数」，好让我们一起核对账单。

collocations: submit a meter reading by phone
submit a meter reading through the app

words.enDefinition: the ability to reach a meter for inspection or reading

examples.en: I asked the building manager about meter access before the supplier's visit tomorrow.
examples.zh: 供应商明天上门前，我先问了管理员怎么取得「进入抄表处的权限」。

examples.en: We arranged meter access with reception because the cupboard was never left unlocked.
examples.zh: 仪表柜平时总是锁着，我们就跟前台约好了供应商怎么「进入抄表处」。

words.enDefinition: the installation of a new meter in place of an old one

examples.en: The landlord gave us a window for the meter replacement on Tuesday afternoon.
examples.zh: 房东告诉我们周二下午「更换计量表」的大致时间。

examples.en: I took a final photo of the old reading before the meter replacement.
examples.zh: 「更换计量表」前，我最后拍了一张旧表读数的照片。

words.enDefinition: the amount of energy used over a period

examples.en: Our energy consumption fell after we stopped heating the rooms nobody used.
examples.zh: 不用的房间不再供暖之后，我们的「能耗」降了。

examples.en: I checked our energy consumption before deciding whether to change electricity plans.
examples.zh: 决定要不要换用电套餐之前，我先查了我们的「能耗」。

words.enDefinition: the energy used by one kilowatt over one hour

examples.en: The new plan charges less for each kilowatt-hour we use overnight at home.
examples.zh: 新套餐下，我们夜间每用一个「千瓦时」都比以前便宜。

examples.en: I compared the price per kilowatt-hour on both offers before choosing a supplier.
examples.zh: 选供应商之前，我对比了两个报价里每「千瓦时」的价格。

words.enDefinition: a unit of heat used on some gas bills

examples.en: The price per therm is printed beside the usage line on my gas bill.
examples.zh: 我那张燃气账单的用量旁边标着每「撒姆」的价格。

examples.en: I asked what a therm was after noticing the unit on our heating bill.
examples.zh: 我在暖气账单上留意到这个单位，就问了「撒姆」是什么意思。

words.enDefinition: a screen that shows usage information from a smart meter

examples.en: Our smart meter display shows how much electricity we used to cook dinner.
examples.zh: 「智能表显示屏」显示了我们做晚饭用了多少电。

examples.en: I checked the smart meter display after turning off every light in the flat.
examples.zh: 把公寓里所有的灯关掉后，我看了看「智能表显示屏」。

collocations: set up a smart meter display

words.enDefinition: the amount of water used in a given period

examples.en: The chart shows that our water consumption rose sharply during the summer holidays.
examples.zh: 图表显示，我们的「用水量」在暑假期间大幅上涨。

examples.en: We checked our water consumption after fixing the leak in the downstairs toilet.
examples.zh: 楼下卫生间的漏水修好后，我们查了「用水量」。

words.enDefinition: a prediction of how much a property will use in one year

examples.en: The comparison site asks for an annual consumption estimate before it shows any prices.
examples.zh: 比价网站要先填「年用量估算」，才会显示价格。

examples.en: Our annual consumption estimate was based on readings taken before we moved in.
examples.zh: 我们的「年用量估算」是根据搬进来前采集的读数算出来的。

words.enDefinition: a sudden sharp increase in the amount of a service used

examples.en: A usage spike during the break made us check for a running toilet.
examples.zh: 假期里「用量骤升」，我们就去查了马桶是不是一直在流水。

examples.en: We noticed a usage spike after a cold weekend when everyone stayed home.
examples.zh: 一个寒冷的周末大家都待在家之后，我们发现「用量骤升」。

words.enDefinition: a bill much larger than expected given normal usage

examples.en: An abnormally high bill prompted us to check which meter the supplier had read.
examples.zh: 一张「明显偏高的账单」让我们去核实供应商读的是哪块表。

examples.en: I took the abnormally high bill to the student housing office for advice.
examples.zh: 我拿着「明显偏高的账单」去学生住宿办公室咨询。

words.enDefinition: a reduction in water charges after a qualifying leak is repaired

examples.en: The water company approved a water leak allowance after we submitted the plumber's invoice.
examples.zh: 我们提交水管工的发票后，自来水公司批准了「漏水费用减免」。

examples.en: Ask what documents you need to claim a water leak allowance at this address.
examples.zh: 问问这个地址要申请「漏水费用减免」需要交哪些材料。

collocations: apply for a water leak allowance
qualify for a water leak allowance

words.enDefinition: a temporary break in the delivery of a service

examples.en: We got a text about a service interruption just before my online seminar.
examples.zh: 就在我的线上研讨课开始前，我们收到一条「服务中断」的短信。

examples.en: The supplier apologized for the service interruption and gave us an estimated return time.
examples.zh: 供应商对「服务中断」表示歉意，并告诉了我们预计恢复的时间。

collocations: notify customers of a service interruption

words.enDefinition: a planned period when a service will be unavailable

examples.en: The scheduled outage starts at noon, so I'll work from the library that day.
examples.zh: 「计划停供」从中午开始，那天我会去图书馆学习。

examples.en: I moved my online meeting after seeing the notice about the scheduled outage.
examples.zh: 看了「计划停供」通知后，我改了线上会议的时间。

words.enDefinition: to notify the electricity provider that the power has stopped

examples.en: I called to report a power outage after checking with the neighbours downstairs.
examples.zh: 我问过楼下的邻居以后，打电话「报告停电」。

examples.en: The provider's website says you can report a power outage without signing in.
examples.zh: 供电公司的网站说不用登录也可以「报告停电」。

collocations: call to report a power outage
report a power outage in your area

words.enDefinition: an online map showing where a service is unavailable

examples.en: The outage map showed that our entire block was affected rather than just our flat.
examples.zh: 「停供范围地图」上显示，受影响的是整片街区，并非只有我们公寓。

examples.en: I checked the outage map before calling to ask when the power would return.
examples.zh: 打电话问什么时候来电之前，我先看了「停供范围地图」。

words.enDefinition: the return of a service after it has stopped

examples.en: The supplier gave us a rough time for service restoration after the storm.
examples.zh: 暴风雨过后，供应商告诉了我们大致的「服务恢复」时间。

examples.en: We checked the website for updates on service restoration before coming back home.
examples.zh: 回家之前，我们上网站看了「服务恢复」的最新进度。

words.enDefinition: a situation in which a home has no working hot water supply

examples.en: There was no hot water in the flat when I returned from class.
examples.zh: 我下课回来时，公寓里「没有热水」。

examples.en: We had no hot water for two days and contacted the housing office.
examples.zh: 我们连续两天「没有热水」，就联系了住宿办公室。

words.enDefinition: a heating system shared by multiple homes in one building

examples.en: Our building uses communal heating instead of having a boiler in each flat.
examples.zh: 我们楼用的是「楼栋共用供暖」，各户没有自己的锅炉。

examples.en: The notice says communal heating will come on at the beginning of October.
examples.zh: 通知说「楼栋共用供暖」将于十月初开始运行。

words.enDefinition: heat supplied to several buildings from a shared central system

examples.en: The housing team told us our hall gets its heat from district heating.
examples.zh: 住宿团队说，我们宿舍楼的热量来自「区域供暖」。

examples.en: District heating serves several blocks, so we don't have a boiler in our flat.
examples.zh: 「区域供暖」覆盖好几座楼，所以我们公寓里没有锅炉。

words.enDefinition: a payment or discount that offsets the cost of an eligible energy-saving purchase or upgrade

examples.en: The landlord checked whether the new water heater qualified for an energy-efficiency rebate from the utility.
examples.zh: 房东查看新热水器是否符合公用事业公司的「节能返款」条件。

examples.en: The utility asked for a receipt before processing our energy-efficiency rebate for the replacement appliance.
examples.zh: 公用事业公司先要求我们出示收据，再办理更换电器的「节能返款」。

words.enDefinition: a score showing how efficiently a building or device uses energy

examples.en: The flat's energy efficiency rating helped us compare likely winter costs before signing.
examples.zh: 签约前，我们用公寓的「能效等级」比较了冬天可能的开销。

examples.en: I asked for the energy efficiency rating because the rooms felt cold even in September.
examples.zh: 才九月房间就觉得冷，所以我问了「能效等级」。

words.enDefinition: a document recording how efficiently a property uses energy

examples.en: The landlord sent the energy performance certificate with the information pack before our viewing.
examples.zh: 看房前，房东把「建筑能效证书」连同资料一起发给了我们。

examples.en: I compared the energy performance certificate for both flats before choosing the warmer one.
examples.zh: 我对比了两套公寓的「建筑能效证书」，最后选了更暖和的。

words.enDefinition: a cupboard that houses utility meters in a property

examples.en: The meter cupboard is in the hall, next to the entrance to the basement.
examples.zh: 「仪表柜」在门厅，就在地下室入口旁边。

examples.en: The caretaker unlocked the meter cupboard so I could photograph the reading before moving out.
examples.zh: 管理员打开了「仪表柜」，好让我搬出去之前拍下读数。

words.enDefinition: a switch that cuts power when a circuit becomes unsafe

examples.en: We called maintenance after the circuit breaker kept switching off in the kitchen.
examples.zh: 厨房里的「断路器」一直跳闸，我们就打电话叫人来维修。

examples.en: The circuit breaker for my room is labelled inside the panel by the door.
examples.zh: 门旁边的配电箱里标明了我房间对应的「断路器」。

words.enDefinition: a valve that stops water flowing into a home

examples.en: The landlord showed us the water shutoff valve before leaving us the keys.
examples.zh: 房东给我们钥匙前，指了「总水阀」的位置。

examples.en: I told the plumber I could not find the water shutoff valve under the sink.
examples.zh: 我告诉水管工，我没在水槽下面找到「总水阀」。

words.enDefinition: the main box that distributes electricity to circuits in a home

examples.en: The caretaker showed me the consumer unit behind the front door of the flat.
examples.zh: 管理员给我指了公寓大门后面的「家用配电箱」。

examples.en: Our electrician labelled each switch in the consumer unit after checking the kitchen sockets.
examples.zh: 电工检查完厨房的插座后，给「家用配电箱」里的每个开关贴了标签。

words.enDefinition: a company that supplies internet access to homes and businesses

examples.en: Our internet service provider asked us to restart the router before arranging a visit.
examples.zh: 「互联网服务提供商」让我们先重启路由器，再安排人员上门。

examples.en: I compared reviews before choosing an internet service provider for the new flat.
examples.zh: 给新公寓选「互联网服务提供商」之前，我先比较了评价。

words.enDefinition: an agreement for internet access under specified terms and prices

examples.en: We checked the broadband contract for charges that might apply if we moved.
examples.zh: 我们查了「宽带合同」，看看搬家时可能要付哪些费用。

examples.en: My broadband contract ends a month after I move out of this flat.
examples.zh: 我的「宽带合同」在我搬出这套公寓一个月后到期。

words.enDefinition: an internet plan sold with a particular speed and price

examples.en: The cheapest broadband package was fast enough for me and my two flatmates.
examples.zh: 最便宜的「宽带套餐」网速也够我和两个室友使用。

examples.en: We compared each broadband package because we only needed access during term time.
examples.zh: 我们比较了各个「宽带套餐」，因为我们只需要在学期内上网。

words.enDefinition: internet access renewed monthly without a long minimum term

examples.en: We chose month-to-month broadband because our summer lease only lasts twelve weeks.
examples.zh: 我们的暑期租约只有十二周，所以我们选了「按月续订的宽带」。

examples.en: Month-to-month broadband looked expensive until we included the cost of leaving a longer contract.
examples.zh: 把长期合约的解约成本也算进去之后，「按月续订的宽带」就没那么贵了。

words.enDefinition: the work needed to connect a property to broadband

examples.en: The broadband installation is on Thursday, so I'll stay home that afternoon.
examples.zh: 周四「安装宽带」，所以那天下午我会在家。

examples.en: We asked the landlord whether broadband installation would require drilling through a wall.
examples.zh: 我们问了房东，「宽带安装」是否需要在墙上钻孔。

words.enDefinition: the day when a service is switched on for use

examples.en: Can you confirm the activation date before I move into the new flat?
examples.zh: 你能在我搬进新公寓之前确认一下「开通日期」吗？

examples.en: The provider moved our activation date to Monday after the engineer became unavailable.
examples.zh: 工程师来不了，供应商把我们的「开通日期」改到了周一。

words.enDefinition: a one-time charge for starting a service

examples.en: The broadband deal looked cheap until we noticed the activation fee in the checkout.
examples.zh: 这个宽带优惠看着便宜，直到我们在付款页面看到「开通费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the company could waive the activation fee for student customers.
examples.zh: 我问公司能否为学生客户免掉「开通费」。

words.enDefinition: an agreed time for a technician to install a service

examples.en: I rescheduled the installation appointment because it clashed with my lab session.
examples.zh: 安装时间和实验课撞了，我就改了「安装预约」。

examples.en: The provider sent a text to confirm our installation appointment for Wednesday morning.
examples.zh: 供应商发短信确认了周三上午的「安装预约」。

words.enDefinition: the equipment and instructions for setting up a service yourself

examples.en: The self-installation kit arrived just in time for the first week of classes.
examples.zh: 「自助安装套件」正好赶在开学第一周到了。

examples.en: Our self-installation kit was missing a cable, so we contacted the broadband company.
examples.zh: 我们的「自助安装套件」少了一根线，所以我们联系了宽带公司。

words.enDefinition: the arrangement of paying to use a provider's router

examples.en: The company offers router rental if you don't want to buy your own equipment.
examples.zh: 如果不想自己买设备，这家公司提供「路由器租用」。

examples.en: I checked whether router rental was included in the price on the broadband website.
examples.zh: 我查了宽带网站上的价格是否包含「路由器租用」。

words.enDefinition: the process of sending rented router equipment back to its provider

examples.en: The shop gave me a receipt for the router return when I cancelled my plan.
examples.zh: 我取消套餐后，在门店「归还路由器」时拿到了一张收据。

examples.en: Check the router return instructions before leaving the flat at the end of term.
examples.zh: 学期末搬出公寓之前，先看一下「归还路由器」的说明。

words.enDefinition: a lower starting price offered to new internet customers

examples.en: The introductory broadband rate only lasts six months, according to the order summary.
examples.zh: 订单摘要写着，「宽带首期优惠价」只维持六个月。

examples.en: We picked a shorter contract after seeing when the introductory broadband rate would end.
examples.zh: 看到「宽带首期优惠价」什么时候结束后，我们选了更短的合约。

collocations: qualify for an introductory broadband rate

words.enDefinition: a limit on how much internet data a customer can use

examples.en: The provider warned us that we were approaching the data cap for this month.
examples.zh: 供应商提醒我们，快达到这个月的「数据用量上限」了。

examples.en: We asked if the plan had a data cap before signing up online.
examples.zh: 网上办理之前，我们先问了这个套餐有没有「数据用量上限」。

words.enDefinition: a plan feature with no fixed limit on data use

examples.en: I chose unlimited data because both my flatmates join video calls most evenings.
examples.zh: 两个室友大多晚上都要开视频会，所以我选了「不限流量」。

examples.en: Unlimited data doesn't tell you how fast the connection will be at busy times.
examples.zh: 「不限流量」并不能说明高峰时段的连接速度有多快。

words.enDefinition: the rate at which data arrives over an internet connection

examples.en: Our download speed drops when everyone in the building gets home from class.
examples.zh: 楼里的人都下课回来时，我们的「下载速度」会变慢。

examples.en: I ran a test to check the download speed before contacting the broadband provider.
examples.zh: 联系宽带供应商之前，我先测了一下「下载速度」。

words.enDefinition: the rate at which data is sent over an internet connection

examples.en: The slow upload speed meant my video project took an hour to submit.
examples.zh: 因为「上传速度」慢，我花了一小时才把视频作业交上去。

examples.en: Ask about the upload speed if you share large files from your flat.
examples.zh: 如果你经常在公寓里分享大文件，就问一下「上传速度」。

words.enDefinition: a stated minimum download speed used to assess poor service

examples.en: The sales email included a minimum guaranteed download speed for our new address.
examples.zh: 销售邮件列出了我们新地址的「最低保证下载速度」。

examples.en: I quoted the minimum guaranteed download speed when I complained about our poor connection.
examples.zh: 投诉网络质量差时，我提到了合同里的「最低保证下载速度」。

collocations: check the minimum guaranteed download speed
below the minimum guaranteed download speed
meet the minimum guaranteed download speed

words.enDefinition: internet service with speeds around one gigabit per second

examples.en: The website says gigabit broadband is available in our new block of flats.
examples.zh: 网站说我们的新公寓楼可以办理「千兆宽带」。

examples.en: We decided gigabit broadband was more than we needed for a two-person flat.
examples.zh: 我们觉得，两人合住的公寓用不上「千兆宽带」。

words.enDefinition: broadband internet delivered using fiber-optic lines for some or all of the connection

examples.en: We checked whether fiber broadband was available before choosing a place off campus.
examples.zh: 我们先查了能不能装「光纤宽带」，然后才选校外住处。

examples.en: Our building finally got fiber broadband, so I can attend seminars from home.
examples.zh: 我们楼终于通了「光纤宽带」，我可以在家上研讨课了。

words.enDefinition: a connection in which fiber runs all the way to a home

examples.en: The engineer confirmed that our building supports fiber-to-the-home rather than just street-level fiber.
examples.zh: 工程师确认我们楼支持「光纤到户」，光纤可以直接接到住处。

examples.en: The availability page showed fiber-to-the-home was an option for the flat upstairs.
examples.zh: 覆盖查询页面显示，楼上那套公寓可以办理「光纤到户」。

words.enDefinition: internet access supplied over a cable television network

examples.en: We used cable internet because it was available before the fiber installation date.
examples.zh: 光纤还没到安装日期，我们就先用了「有线电视网宽带」。

examples.en: Our landlord said cable internet was still active when the previous tenants left.
examples.zh: 房东说，上任租客离开时，「有线电视网宽带」还没停。

words.enDefinition: home internet delivered by radio signals to a fixed location

examples.en: The landlord suggested fixed wireless broadband because the flat had no cable connection.
examples.zh: 公寓没有有线连接，房东建议用「固定无线宽带」。

examples.en: We asked whether fixed wireless broadband would work in our basement flat.
examples.zh: 我们问了地下室的公寓能不能用「固定无线宽带」。

words.enDefinition: a period when an internet service is unavailable

examples.en: An internet outage cut off my video call halfway through the student meeting.
examples.zh: 学生会议开到一半时，「网络中断」把我的视频通话切断了。

examples.en: I checked whether the internet outage affected other flats before calling for help.
examples.zh: 联系报修之前，我查了这次「网络中断」有没有影响别的公寓。

words.enDefinition: a connection that repeatedly drops and comes back

examples.en: The intermittent connection made it hard to follow the lecturer's instructions from home.
examples.zh: 网络「间歇断线」，我在家很难跟上老师的讲解。

examples.en: I reported an intermittent connection after my video call froze for the third time.
examples.zh: 视频通话第三次卡住后，我报修了网络「间歇断线」的问题。

words.enDefinition: a separate Wi-Fi network for people visiting a home

examples.en: I set up a guest network before my classmates came over to study.
examples.zh: 同学来家里学习前，我开了一个「访客网络」。

examples.en: The guest network lets visitors connect without using our shared household password.
examples.zh: 使用「访客网络」来客就能上网，不用知道家里共用的密码。

words.enDefinition: a recurring charge for using a line that carries broadband

examples.en: The headline price didn't include broadband line rental, so the monthly cost was higher.
examples.zh: 醒目的报价没算「宽带线路月租费」，所以实际月费更高。

examples.en: I checked whether broadband line rental was still charged when we stopped using the phone.
examples.zh: 停用座机后，我查了还会不会收「宽带线路月租费」。

words.enDefinition: a fee charged for ending an agreement before its minimum term

examples.en: The broadband provider wanted an early termination fee when my exchange semester ended.
examples.zh: 我的交换学期结束时，宽带供应商要收「提前解约费」。

examples.en: Ask about the early termination fee before agreeing to a two-year broadband plan.
examples.zh: 同意办两年期宽带之前，先问清「提前解约费」。

words.enDefinition: a label with mailing details for sending equipment back

examples.en: The provider emailed a return shipping label for the router after we moved.
examples.zh: 我们搬家后，供应商发邮件寄来还路由器用的「退寄标签」。

examples.en: Print the return shipping label before taking the broadband equipment to the parcel shop.
examples.zh: 把宽带设备送去包裹代收点前，先把「退寄标签」打印出来。

words.enDefinition: the price charged after the minimum contract term ends

examples.en: Our out-of-contract price was much higher than what we paid in the first year.
examples.zh: 我们的「合约期满后价格」比第一年付的高很多。

examples.en: I checked the out-of-contract price before deciding whether to keep the broadband plan.
examples.zh: 决定是否继续用这个宽带套餐前，我查了「合约期满后的价格」。

words.enDefinition: a check to see which services can reach a given address

examples.en: The service availability check showed only one broadband provider for our basement flat.
examples.zh: 「服务覆盖查询」显示，我们地下室的公寓只有一家宽带供应商可选。

examples.en: I ran a service availability check before putting down a deposit on the flat.
examples.zh: 交公寓押金之前，我做了一次「服务覆盖查询」。

words.enDefinition: to divide the cost of household services among several people

examples.en: We agreed to split utility bills according to how long each person stayed.
examples.zh: 我们同意按照每个人住的时间来「分摊水电等费用」。

examples.en: My flatmates use an app to split utility bills at the end of each month.
examples.zh: 月底室友们会用一个应用来「分摊水电等费用」。

words.enDefinition: a utility bill covering a proportion of a full billing period

examples.en: I received a prorated utility bill for the ten days before my flatmate arrived.
examples.zh: 我收到了室友入住前十天的「按天折算的公用账单」。

examples.en: The prorated utility bill covered only the last two weeks of our summer lease.
examples.zh: 这份「按天折算的公用账单」只包括暑期租约最后两周。

words.enDefinition: a set utility charge that does not depend on usage

examples.en: Our hall uses a flat-rate utility charge to cover heating and electricity.
examples.zh: 我们宿舍楼用一笔「统一标准的公用费」来支付供暖和电费。

examples.en: I asked whether the flat-rate utility charge stayed the same over the summer.
examples.zh: 我问夏天收的「统一标准公用费」是不是也一样。

words.enDefinition: with utility charges payable in addition to the stated price

examples.en: The flat looked cheaper until we noticed the words utilities billed separately online.
examples.zh: 这套公寓原先看着便宜，后来我们在网上看到「公用费用另计」几个字。

examples.en: A place with utilities billed separately can cost more once you include winter heating.
examples.zh: 如果「公用费用另计」，把冬季供暖算进去后，这个住处可能更贵。
